data.title: 妮姆芙 · 晨曦床褥浅蓝睡衬衫的蜷缩依恋
data.description: 初升晨曦透过薄纱窗帘，妮姆芙裹在过大的浅蓝色半透居家睡衬衫里，怀里紧紧抱着大抱枕蜷在软垫上，透明小光翼微颤，双眸带着依恋与初醒的朦胧。
data.action: 抱膝侧卧在白色床褥上，下巴抵在巨大抱枕顶端，袖子遮过手掌，眼神毫无防备地注视前方
data.lighting: 温软淡金晨曦斜照床单，光线将薄衬衫边缘勾勒出透光轮廓
data.camera: 平视近景床边机位，极尽柔和亲昵的生活感
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, nymph, small translucent fairy angel wings gently resting, aqua blue hair in messy low twintails, sleepy blue eyes, oversized sheer pastel blue button-up nightshirt, sleeves covering hands, hugging plush body pillow curled up on soft white bed sheets, early morning golden sunlight streaming across bed, innocent sweet affection, vulnerable tender awakening.
